news.title: Justo Realfintech Limited Announces Appointment of Jignesha Fofandi as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective April 1, 2026
news.body: Justo Realfintech Limited at its board meeting held on February 16, 2026 approved the appointment of Ms. Jignesha Fofandi as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective April 1, 2026. Ms. Jignesha Fofandi (A72393) is an Associate Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) and has experience heading the compliance under the Companies Act, 2013, Listing Regulation and other relevant laws related to the corporate sector.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.5% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent.
